report.clinical_summary: The patient has HIV and is on Biktarvy. They report significant improvement since starting treatment - fatigue and headaches have become more manageable, and they have more energy. Their viral load has been undetectable for over a year. They experience occasional side effects (headaches, mild GI discomfort) but these don't disrupt their routine. They view their condition as lifelong but manageable, with good adherence and a healthy lifestyle giving them significant control. They have some emotional ups and downs (worry, frustration, occasional unease about future progression) but find comfort in understanding their illness.

evidence.quote: Before starting my treatment, it felt like every day was a struggle. I had little energy and couldn't keep up with my usual routine.
Day-to-day tasks that used to feel overwhelming — like going to work or spending time with family — are much more manageable now.
There are days where the occasional fatigue or headaches remind me of its presence, but for the most part, things have been stable.

While there are still aspects of life I can't fully control due to my condition — like occasional symptoms or limitations when my energy level is low — I try not to let it affect my day-to-day too much.
